title: Algebra I, Algebra II, and Geometry existing-engine extension audit
strategy: extend existing high-level engines before creating new widget types
honestTierRationale: Tier A requires an authored prediction/consequence/revision cycle. These lessons lacked that cycle; inserting one only to satisfy the rubric would alter authored pedagogy. Tier B is therefore the verified resting tier.

groups.truthModel: linear relation state plus ordered equivalence-preserving operations
interactivity: choose same operation for both sides
observe inequality reversal under a negative scale
undo or clear the transformation path
enter or select the final result

masteryColor.leaf: valid same operation and correctly ordered step
masteryColor.berry: direction flip, non-equivalent route, or wrong-order diagnosis

groups.truthModel: finite or rule-generated sequence, common change, terms, partial sums, and exact stages
interactivity: answer numerically or by a unique semantic claim

masteryColor.leaf: valid derived stage or selected truth

groups.truthModel: labelled points, segments, slopes, squared distances, areas, vectors, and intersections
interactivity: select or enter the derived conclusion

masteryColor.berry: contrasting relation, second segment, or diagnostic route
masteryColor.nonColorRedundancy: labels, coordinates, solid/dashed lines, stage text, and ARIA narration preserve meaning without color
